exposure: sacroiliac joint injection (local anesthetic plus corticosteroid)
outcome: diagnosis of acute postpartum inflammatory sacroiliitis
reduction of abnormal signal in MRI
cohort: The study included eleven patients diagnosed with acute postpartum inflammatory sacroiliitis from 2014 to 2020.
finding: Systemic NSAIDs, sacroiliac joint injections, and physical therapy effectively alleviated pain and resolved symptoms in patients with acute postpartum inflammatory sacroiliitis, for which MRI proved a useful diagnostic method.
